title: Todos
summary: A list of things you mean to do.
It exists so nothing you meant to do gets forgotten.
You add a thing, tick it when it is done, and delete it when it no longer matters.

stories.sentence: You type "buy milk" and press Add; "buy milk" appears in the list, not ticked.
You tick "buy milk"; it shows as done and stays in the list.
You press Add with nothing typed; nothing is added.
You delete "buy milk"; it is gone from the list.
